info.name: Get network-wide marketplace and token statistics

items.docs: Returns the aggregate Braintrust network dashboard — totals for clients, jobs, proposals, talent, token holders and earners, lifetime network GSV, BTRST fee and token-earning totals — plus the weekly GSV time series since January 2020.

info.name: Get average hourly rates by skill

items.docs: Returns the average hourly rate for each skill on the Braintrust talent network (~1,100 skills observed).

info.name: Get the public BTRST token-earner leaderboard

items.docs: Returns the public token-earner list — first name, last initial, avatar, referral counts, jobs filled, GSV and BTRST tokens earned per community member.
